description.value:
As a swift action, the blue mage may focus all her attention on casting a single spell. Only spells with a casting time of 1 standard action and a range of personal or touch may be cast in this way. The blue mage adds her level to any concentration check made to cast a spell when using spell diligence. The blue mage may use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + her Intelligence modifier.

* This talent adds effects to a blue mage's spellcasting ability. Only one of these talents can be applied to an individual spell and the decision must be made before the spell is cast.
